node.title: Rate-half FPC5 codimension-two cells collapse under the background guard
node.statement: On the official rate-half row, an M=4,t=2 full-petal cell whose unguarded petal-equation locator codimension is two necessarily has 5ell=k+4 and b=r=s=ell-3, where d=ell+s=2ell-3. Let L_0 be the full background locator and L_1,L_2 the touched-petal locators, with distinct nonzero labels c_1,c_2. Every contributor lies in the guarded slice L_0|W and L_i|(W-c_iF). This slice is isomorphic to cofactor pairs deg A_i<=ell-3 satisfying c_2L_1A_1 congruent to c_1L_2A_2 modulo L_0. It has dimension ell-1, its projection to the F-locator space is injective, and its locator codimension is ell-1. Split-on-core, primitive, exact-nonagreement, and first-owner conditions remain to be counted.
